description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different models—Americanisms, Dates, Normalised, Add Spacing, and Remove Spacing—across two evaluation metrics: NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model. The categories, representing the models, are listed vertically on the left axis, in the order of Americanisms, Dates, Normalised, Add Spacing, and Remove Spacing. The horizontal axis represents the performance value, labeled as “Model”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick marks at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. For each model, there are two bars representing the two evaluation metrics. The “NESAC ft model” is represented by an orange bar, while the “SESHA ft model” is represented by a green bar. For the Americanisms model, the orange bar has a value of approximately 0.00299, and the green bar has a value of approximately 0.00302. The Dates model has an orange bar with a value of approximately 0.00228 and a green bar with a value of approximately 0.00257. The Normalised model has an orange bar with a value of approximately 0.00334 and a green bar with a value of approximately 0.00323. The Add Spacing model has an orange bar with a value of approximately 0.00319 and a green bar with a value of approximately 0.00344. The Remove Spacing model has an orange bar with a value of approximately 0.00311 and a green bar with a value of approximately 0.00306. The bars are arranged in pairs, with the orange “NESAC ft model” bar appearing to the left of the green “SESHA ft model” bar for each model category. No bars are visually emphasized.
